sections.name: 阅读理解
sections.note: 每题 2 分。阅读所给文章，从四个选项中选出最佳答案。

passage.title: Why city trees are health infrastructure
passage.text: City trees are usually discussed as decoration. A growing body of medical evidence suggests they should be discussed as infrastructure. Researchers tracking thousands of residents found that people living within a short walk of mature trees reported lower stress and slept longer, even after income and noise were taken into account. The effect was strongest in the hottest months, when shade lowered surface temperatures by several degrees. None of this makes trees a substitute for clinics. It does mean that a decision to remove a row of trees for a wider road is a health decision, and should be costed as one. A few cities have begun to do exactly that, listing the medical savings alongside the construction costs in their planning documents.

sections.name: 翻译
sections.note: 本题 12 分。把划线句子译成汉语，要求准确、通顺。

items.stem: It does mean that a decision to remove a row of trees for a wider road is a health decision, and should be costed as one.

answer.text: 它确实意味着，为拓宽道路而砍掉一排树的决定是一个健康决策，并且应当按健康决策来核算成本。

explain.right: 先切分意群定主干，再按汉语习惯重排语序，最后检查术语与指代是否统一。
explain.wrong: 常见错误：It 指代前句「树不能替代诊所」这一让步；a decision to remove… 的不定式作后置定语，译成「为……而砍树的决定」；cost as one 中的 one 指 a health decision，需还原。

sections.name: 写作
sections.note: 本题 12 分。按题目要求写一篇短文。

items.stem: Write an essay of about 160 words on the following topic: some cities are cutting down street trees to widen roads. State the problem, analyse its consequences, and suggest what city governments should do.

answer.text: Several cities have removed mature street trees to make room for extra lanes. The immediate gain is shorter queues at rush hour; the losses are less visible and last longer. Mature trees cool streets in summer, absorb noise, and, according to medical research, reduce stress among nearby residents. Once cut, they take decades to replace. The rational response is not to forbid road widening but to price what is being destroyed. Planners should publish the health and cooling benefits of a tree row beside the construction budget, and plant replacements before removal begins. When the trade-off is visible, citizens can judge whether a wider road is worth the shade it costs.

explain.right: 先定三段骨架（描述—分析—结论），再把题目给出的信息逐条落进段落，最后检查字数与衔接词。
explain.wrong: 常见错误：只写「树很重要」的口号，没有把健康成本与工程预算联系起来；或提出「一律不修路」的极端主张。

framework.title: 图画作文
steps: 首段：一句点图（As is vividly depicted…），再写 2 句细节
二段：一句点寓意，再展开因果或举例
三段：一句总结 + 一句建议/展望
用具体名词替换万能词（people→students/employees）
framework.trap: 只描述图画不解释寓意，二段空洞
